value.rationale: The defining 2023 paper explicitly asks for sharp minimum covering-family sizes, a natural extremal invariant. Here the first four binary cases after the known base value are determined and its general cyclic upper bound is shown sharp at n=3..6. A nine-word finite obstruction proves that three arbitrary coordinate permutations do not suffice at n=6; this is a concrete structural hurdle to any improved small-order or asymptotic bound. The exact finite classification is useful in its own right and does not rely on unsupported significance for n>=7.
